items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: I joined Johnnie Brown's Playtone Orchestra. ... We played Oxford, Mississippi. ... We headed on down to Granada, Mississippi

ctx.x: And this same -- a buddy of mine, the fellow who got me that first job I told you about, "Toe" Morgan. His name was James "Toe" Morgan. He had a job in Jackson, Tennessee, and asked me did I want to go over to Jackson, Tennessee, and join the Johnnie Brown's orchestra. Johnnie Brown and his Playtone Orchestra.

This was a time when I told you that I left home. And my mother told me she was going to let me leave home. And that all she would ask of me was to be a good boy, and use common sense, and think of your mother while you're away. And this I did. And I joined Johnnie Brown's Playtone Orchestra. I arrived there on a Sunday, and we left Monday morning for Mississippi..
